description: This file declares the UnixDomainServerSocket class, which implements a server socket using Unix domain sockets with support for abstract namespaces on Linux and Android. It includes methods for binding, listening, accepting connections, and retrieving peer credentials.

classes.name: UnixDomainServerSocket
classes.description: A server socket class that uses Unix domain sockets as the transport layer, supporting abstract namespaces on Linux and Android.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: A struct representing the credentials of a peer process connected to the socket, including process ID (on certain platforms), user ID, and group ID.

methods.name: UnixDomainServerSocket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket with an authentication callback and a flag for using abstract namespace.

methods.name: GetPeerCredentials
methods.description: Static method to retrieve credentials of the peer connected to a given socket descriptor.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified IP endpoint with a given backlog and optional IPv6-only flag.

methods.name: ListenWithAddressAndPort
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified address string and port with a given backlog.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns a StreamSocket.

methods.name: BindAndListen
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a socket at the specified socket path.

methods.name: AcceptSocketDescriptor
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns a raw socket descriptor.
